What You’ll Bring

  • Italian and English at C2 level;
  • Previous sales experience - mandatory;
  • Experience in technical support or a contact centre is an advantage;
  • An interest in telecommunications and a practical approach to troubleshooting;
  • Strong communication, listening and persuasive skills;
  • Patience and confidence explaining technical steps;
  • Comfort using digital tools and learning new systems;
  • The ability to balance customer needs with commercial objectives;
  • Availability to work remotely from mainland Portugal on rotating shifts.

Working Conditions

  • 100% remote within mainland Portugal;
  • Rotating eight-hour shifts between 07:00 and 21:00, scheduled across Monday to Sunday;
  • Permanent contract after six months;
  • Paid training and full onboarding.

Salary and Benefits

  • Base salary: €920 per month;
  • Language allowance: €250 per month;
  • Performance bonus: up to €360 per month;
  • Attendance allowance: €110 per month;
  • Flex work allowance: €60 per month;
  • Meal allowance: €10.20 per working day;
  • Private health insurance;
  • Ongoing training, coaching and professional development;
  • Career development and internal progression opportunities;
  • An international, multicultural working environment.

The performance bonus is variable. Allowances are subject to their applicable conditions, and the meal allowance depends on the number of days worked.

  • Aisance avec les outils informatiques et capacité à apprendre de nouveaux systèmes ;
